description: 帮我使用html画一个鹈鹕骑自行车的svg动画

arguments.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>鹈鹕骑自行车</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: linear-gradient(#8ed3f0, #d6f0fb 70%, #bfe6c1 70%);
    font-family: sans-serif;
  }
  .stage {
    width: min(92vw, 900px);
    height: auto;
    display: block;
  }

  /* 车轮旋转 */
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  .wheel {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: center;
    animation: spin 1.1s linear infinite;
  }

  /* 踏板曲柄旋转 */
  @keyframes crank { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  .crank {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: center;
    animation: crank 1.1s linear infinite;
  }

  /* 鹈鹕身体上下颠簸 */
  @keyframes bob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px); } }
  .pelican {
    animation: bob 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  /* 翅膀扑动 */
  @keyframes flap { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(-14deg); } }
  .wing {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: 15% 80%;
    animation: flap 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  /* 云飘动 */
  @keyframes drift { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-900px); } }
  .clouds { animation: drift 22s linear infinite; }

  /* 地面滚动条纹 */
  @keyframes ground { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-120px); } }
  .groundline { animation: ground 0.6s linear infinite; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg class="stage" viewBox="0 0 900 460" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <!-- 云 -->
  <g class="clouds" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">
    <g transform="translate(120,70)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="42" ry="24"/>
      <ellipse cx="34" cy="8" rx="34" ry="20"/>
      <ellipse cx="-32" cy="8" rx="30" ry="18"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(520,50)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="46" ry="26"/>
      <ellipse cx="38" cy="10" rx="36" ry="22"/>
      <ellipse cx="-36" cy="10" rx="32" ry="20"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(820,90)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="38" ry="22"/>
      <ellipse cx="30" cy="8" rx="30" ry="18"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(1220,70)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="42" ry="24"/>
      <ellipse cx="34" cy="8" rx="34" ry="20"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(1620,55)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="46" ry="26"/>
      <ellipse cx="38" cy="10" rx="36" ry="22"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 地面滚动条纹 -->
  <g class="groundline" stroke="#8fbf7a" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="40 80">
    <line x1="0" y1="400" x2="1020" y2="400"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 自行车 ============ -->
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- 后轮 -->
    <g class="wheel">
      <circle cx="250" cy="330" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="10"/>
      <circle cx="250" cy="330" r="70" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4"/>
      <g stroke="#777" stroke-width="3">
        <line x1="250" y1="260" x2="250" y2="400"/>
        <line x1="180" y1="330" x2="320" y2="330"/>
        <line x1="200" y1="280" x2="300" y2="380"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="280" x2="200" y2="380"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="250" cy="330" r="8" fill="#333"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 前轮 -->
    <g class="wheel">
      <circle cx="620" cy="330" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="10"/>
      <circle cx="620" cy="330" r="70" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4"/>
      <g stroke="#777" stroke-width="3">
        <line x1="620" y1="260" x2="620" y2="400"/>
        <line x1="550" y1="330" x2="690" y2="330"/>
        <line x1="570" y1="280" x2="670" y2="380"/>
        <line x1="670" y1="280" x2="570" y2="380"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="620" cy="330" r="8" fill="#333"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 车架 -->
    <g stroke="#d63b3b" stroke-width="12" fill="none">
      <line x1="250" y1="330" x2="430" y2="330"/>   <!-- 下管 -->
      <line x1="430" y1="330" x2="360" y2="210"/>   <!-- 立管到座 -->
      <line x1="250" y1="330" x2="360" y2="210"/>   <!-- 后上管 -->
      <line x1="360" y1="210" x2="430" y2="330"/>   <!-- 座管 -->
      <line x1="430" y1="330" x2="620" y2="330"/>   <!-- 前下叉 -->
      <line x1="620" y1="330" x2="560" y2="180"/>   <!-- 前叉到把 -->
      <line x1="430" y1="330" x2="560" y2="180"/>   <!-- 上管 -->
    </g>

    <!-- 车座 -->
    <rect x="335" y="196" width="60" height="18" rx="8" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
    <!-- 车把 -->
    <path d="M560,180 q40,-6 62,18" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="10"/>
    <!-- 链条 -->
    <circle cx="430" cy="330" r="26" fill="none" stroke="#666" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="250" y1="318" x2="430" y2="314" stroke="#666" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="250" y1="342" x2="430" y2="346" stroke="#666" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 踏板曲柄 -->
    <g class="crank">
      <line x1="430" y1="330" x2="470" y2="372" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="8"/>
      <line x1="430" y1="330" x2="390" y2="288" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="8"/>
      <rect x="455" y="366" width="34" height="12" rx="4" fill="#111"/>
      <rect x="371" y="282" width="34" height="12" rx="4" fill="#111"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="430" cy="330" r="8" fill="#333"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 鹈鹕 ============ -->
  <g class="pelican">
    <!-- 腿踩踏板 -->
    <g stroke="#f2a93b" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <path d="M400,250 q-20,40 -10,82"/>
      <path d="M430,250 q40,40 40,82"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 身体 -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="215" rx="95" ry="70" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e3e3e3" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 翅膀(扑动) -->
    <path class="wing" d="M360,200 q-70,20 -60,70 q50,10 100,-20 q-10,-40 -40,-50 z"
          fill="#f3f3f3" stroke="#dcdcdc" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 尾巴 -->
    <path d="M480,220 q40,10 45,45 q-30,5 -55,-15 z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e3e3e3" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 脖子 -->
    <path d="M470,180 q60,-10 78,-70 q10,-40 -10,-60" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="34" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- 头 -->
    <circle cx="552" cy="42" r="34" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e3e3e3" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 大嘴(鹈鹕特征) -->
    <path d="M560,38 q95,10 110,34 q-70,22 -112,-6 z" fill="#f5c451" stroke="#e0a52e" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- 喉囊 -->
    <path d="M560,52 q60,40 60,80 q-40,10 -70,-30 z" fill="#f7d074" stroke="#e0a52e" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 眼睛 -->
    <circle cx="548" cy="34" r="6" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
    <circle cx="550" cy="32" r="2" fill="#fff"/>

    <!-- 头顶小羽 -->
    <path d="M545,10 q-6,-16 6,-22 q2,12 -2,22 z" fill="#f5c451"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 速度线 -->
  <g stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="120" y1="250" x2="60" y2="250"/>
    <line x1="140" y1="290" x2="70" y2="290"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="330" x2="60" y2="330"/>
  </g>

</svg>
</body>
</html>
